column2: AN ACT TO AMEND THE VALUE ADDED TAX  ACT, NO. 14 OF 2002
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:-

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Value  Added  Tax

2.
Section  2A  of  the  Value  Added  Tax  Act,  No.14  of
2002 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is
hereby amended by the deletion of subsections (2), (3), (4)
and (5) thereof, and the substitution therefor of the following
new subsections which shall take effect as subsections (2)
